newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Ariad rated outperform.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Ariad rated outperform.

text.p: --EVEREN Securities Inc said it is initiating coverage of Ariad Pharmaceuticals Inc with an outperform rating for the intermediate six-month and long-term 18-month periods.
--Its price targets on the company's stock are $12 for the intermediate six-month term and $15 for the long term.

--Ariad is an emerging pharmaceutical company which brings together several modern drug discovery-delivery technologies in order to optimize small molecule discovery and create new approaches for regulated gene therapy, EVEREN analyst Jeffrey Kraws said in a report.
